audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says your all-in 'gets blanked if you chase her in'. Entering the mist is exactly what makes her targetable again.
audit.why: Riot's Hallowed Mist text: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' The restriction is on enemies standing OUTSIDE. Step into the cloud and Shield Vault has a target again. The page had the mechanic backwards, which turns a solvable problem into a reason to give up the trade.
audit.corrected: You cannot target her from outside the mist — so walk into it. Inside, Shield Vault works normally.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings treat Hallowed Mist as a level-6 arrival, and spikes[3] describes a 'percent-true Q' that merges two different abilities.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is her W on 22/21/20/19/18 — available from level 2, not 6. And the two damage types are separate: A Thousand Cuts is bonus MAGIC damage scaling on your health that also heals her, while Snip Snip! deals true damage only 'to units in the center' of the cone. Standing at the edge of the cone avoids the true damage and the passive application on that snip.
audit.corrected: Mist is a 22s W she can have from level 2; the true damage is the centre of Snip Snip!, and A Thousand Cuts is the health-scaling magic damage that heals her.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Skip 'n Slash is called only 'her E dash'.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist 22s at rank 1, Snip Snip! 6.5s down to 3.5s, Skip 'n Slash 13s but 'partially refunded' if she hits an enemy during the buff, Needlework 120s with up to three casts. Mist's 22s against Shield Vault's 13s is the engage rhythm; the E refund is why chasing her never runs it out.
audit.corrected: Numbers throughout; the Skip 'n Slash refund condition stated.

audit.why: 51.65% over 666 games with the chart giving Pantheon everything except level 6 — right for a lane where Gwen has no answer before Hallowed Mist and outscales hard after two items.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours and you have to cash them in. At level 1 your point-and-click W stun plus an auto already wins the trade before she has any mist to hide in. Hit level 2 (W+Q) and you can flat all-in her — she has no Hallowed Mist yet, so there's nowhere for her to vanish. Use Aegis Assault to eat her Snip Snip! Q autos and empowered-Q tap her whenever she steps up to last-hit. Just don't dump your whole combo chasing — bait her E dash, then W-stun.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours and you have to cash them in. At level 1 Shield Vault's leap-stun plus an auto wins the trade before Hallowed Mist is ranked at all. At 2 you can flat all-in her. When she snips, stand off the centre of the cone: only the centre deals true damage and applies A Thousand Cuts, which is what heals her off you. Bait Skip 'n Slash first — landing a hit on you refunds part of its 13 seconds — then W-stun her.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke and E blocks, but it tightens once Hallowed Mist exists. The moment she hits 6 and drops W, you cannot target her from outside the mist — so your W gap-close gets blanked if you dive into it. All-in only when her mist is on cooldown or you can W her before she places it. Grand Starfall is your real level-6 value here: leave this lane to snowball others rather than forcing a fight into her mist.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke, but it tightens once Hallowed Mist is ranked. Read the mist correctly: only enemies OUTSIDE it cannot target her, so walking into the cloud restores your Shield Vault target. Otherwise all-in on its 22s downtime, or stun her before she places it. Grand Starfall is your real level-6 value here: leave this lane and snowball another one rather than forcing a fight inside her cloud.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/gwen__pantheon.json. Consistent with it — Aegis Assault is the front-only block on 22s, Mortal Will merely empowers the next spell, and I did not claim Aegis Assault blocks Needlework specifically, which that audit correctly refused to assert. The headline fix here is that the page had Hallowed Mist backwards: Riot says she 'can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist', so walking IN is the counterplay, not the trap the page described. Second, the mist is her W on 22s and available from level 2, not something that 'comes online' at 6. Third, 'percent-true Q' merged two abilities: the true damage is the centre of Snip Snip!, and A Thousand Cuts is health-scaling magic damage that heals her — which is the anti-heal case _missing-interactions.json flags.
